label: Paid weekly holiday: minimum contractual hours for entitlement
unit: hours per week, averaged over four weeks
appliesTo: All employees, including part-time and fixed-term
why: The single most consequential line in Korean part-time work. Below it there is no paid weekly holiday, no statutory severance and reduced social insurance exposure, so a one-hour difference in a contract changes the employer's cost by far more than one hour of pay. It is a standing target of reform proposals in both directions, and it is measured on contractual hours averaged over four weeks, not on the hours any single week happened to produce.

history.source: Labor Standards Act, art. 18(3) and art. 55
history.note: Where the average weekly contractual hours over four weeks fall below 15, the paid weekly holiday provisions do not apply. The test runs on contractual hours; a week shortened by a public holiday or a company closure does not by itself reduce them.
